headline: Wall Street Ends Shortened Trading Week on a High Note as Stocks Surge
summary: US stock markets ended higher on Friday, capping off a strong week on Wall Street with the Dow jumping 1.2% and the S&P 500 rising 1.6% despite mixed sessions earlier in the week.
why: Broad market index rallies reflect overall investor confidence and liquidity trends across major US asset classes.

impacts.name: S&P 500
impacts.why: Major US equity indexes closed higher on broad buying at the end of the week.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Bargain hunting and buying pressure at the end of the holiday-shortened week lifted major US equity indexes to weekly gains.
